text:
[LSCO.5.1] Orders-of-magnitude targets. Real deployments can sit inside
or outside these; the language is designed for these and is
not expected to scale gracefully outside them.

| Dimension | Typical | Upper end of design target |
|---|---|---|
| Live facts in working memory | 100_s – 1,000_s | ~10,000 |
| Rules per tier | 10_s – 100_s | ~1,000 |
| Fact assertion rate | 10_s / second | ~1,000 / second at the high-frequency end |
| Rule-fire rate | 1_s – 100_s / second | ~10,000 / second peak |
| Cache entries | 10_s – 100_s | ~10,000 |
| Sampled series | 10_s | ~100 |
| Events persisted / day | 1,000_s – 100,000_s | ~10M |
| Adapters (bridges + services) | 5 – 20 | ~50 |
| Tiers | 1 – 3 | ~5 |
| Rule-fire latency budget | ≤ 1 ms typical | ≤ 100 µs at the tightest |
